meta.name: The Bunchy Tops
meta.industry: independent band (reggae-rock / indie surf, Maui HI)
meta.positioning: island energy, east coast grit — sun-faded indie surf, windows-down at 2pm, never resort-tropical
meta.audience: 16-35 surfers/skaters/creatives; Maui locals; Mac DeMarco / Ocean Alley / Jack Johnson listeners
meta.primary_goal: convert visitors into Spotify listeners and IG followers; get locals to shows
meta.maturity: thin (2 singles, real footage/photos, no logo system — full rebrand engagement, blank slate)

register.aesthetic_family: vintage-surf-poster (retro screenprint x washed-out film x editorial)
reference_worlds: THE band's own gig poster (brands/bunchytops/reference-gig-poster.jpg) — the canonical reference: illustrated truck on a coastal cliff, halftone print texture, chunky 70s hand-lettered two-tone title with dark keyline
a 1970s surf-competition screenprint poster — dusty inks, misregistered layers, cream paper
an overexposed 35mm beach photo — highlights blown soft, color faded
windows-down coast drive at 2pm, salt on the windshield
anti_references: hype EDM/artist-agency sites (strobe, countdown timers, STREAM NOW)
clean SaaS landing grammar (centered hero + 3-card features)
dark moody nocturne register (the rejected first draft — this brand lives in daylight)
register.extrapolation_principle: USER DIRECTIVE (2026-07-06, locked with the hero): the gig poster is the SEED, not the spec — extrapolate the vibe, don't replicate the artifact. The poster's DNA concentrates in display type (bounced keylined two-tone), texture (paper/halftone/keylines), and palette; layout, motion, and interaction should speak fluent WEB — scroll-driven moments, layered video, live players, things paper can't do. Literal poster pastiche in every section is an anti-pattern; a section that feels like the poster's world without quoting it is the target.

color.seed: bleached beach paper + sun-flare apricot, everything 20% desaturated with lifted blacks

canvas.name: Poster Paper
canvas.note: page background — aged cream print stock, never pure white

surface.name: Aged Paper
surface.note: cards, alternating sections — one value step down, like a second sheet

surface-deep.name: Sea Pine
surface-deep.note: the poster's sage-teal ocean, deepened — the ONE dark anchor section (music slabs)

ink.name: Walnut
ink.note: primary text + keylines — warm print-brown, never pure black

ink-muted.name: Driftwood
ink-muted.note: secondary text — the ONLY second text value per bg; AA-body on canvas and surface

accent.name: Dusty Terracotta
accent.note: the poster's BUNCHY ink — CTA fills, display-type fills (ALWAYS with Walnut keyline at display size), marks; never running text

accent-2.name: Mustard
accent-2.note: the poster's TOPS ink — the second display-type fill and small marks; two-tone alternation with Terracotta is the title signature; never running text

wild.name: Sage Sea
wild.note: the poster's ocean sage — sub-headline display type, dividers, section tints

motion_aliases.flare: Mustard at 0.10 alpha for soft sun washes
motion_aliases.trail: ink at 0.18 alpha for dub-echo ghosts
motion_aliases.misprint: Terracotta and Sage Sea at 0.5 alpha, ±2px offset, for the print-misregistration hover

display.case: UPPERCASE for the wordmark/hero title (poster register); lowercase ok for section titles
display.note: chunky 70s hand-lettered bubble per the gig poster — display fills in Dusty Terracotta / Mustard two-tone with a 2-3px Walnut keyline (-webkit-text-stroke) + offset shadow; NEVER naked accent-colored type without the keyline
display.hand_pulled_bounce: flat-set display type is BANNED at hero/wordmark size — hand-lettered means irregular: wrap each glyph in a span with a deterministic bounce pattern (baseline offset cycling roughly -0.06em/+0.03em/-0.02em/+0.05em, rotation ±2.5deg alternating, scale 0.97-1.06), occasional letter dropped/raised harder like the poster's Y and S; pattern is fixed (no runtime random) so it renders identically every load; keyline+shadow apply per glyph; reduced-motion unaffected (this is static layout, not animation)

mono.use: gig dates, track metadata, footer legalese — uppercase, +0.08em tracking, zine-label register

type.scale: clamp-based; hero clamp(56px, 9vw, 128px); ratio 1.333 below display

motion_tokens.note: slow and easy — the site grooves at 90 BPM, never bounces

tokens.elevation: no drop shadows; depth via surface value steps and soft sun-flare washes (box-shadow 0 0 64px flare-alias)

imagery.strategy: real-first — band footage and Maui landscape only; zero stock, zero AI-generated people
imagery.art_direction: sun-wash everything: lift blacks hard (faded shadows, no true black), bloom the highlights soft and warm (overexposed 35mm), desaturate ~20%, slight warm cast; film grain overlay at 0.04-0.06 opacity on all media; daytime drone/coast footage leads — night garage clips are the exception, used small and graded to match the wash, never full-bleed

recipes: dub-echo entrance: element enters with one soft ghost trail (translateY 28px -> 0, ghost at trail-alias alpha lagging 120ms), ease swell
heat-haze drift: hero media and large display type drift very slowly (scale 1.0 -> 1.04 over scroll), like heat shimmer — barely perceptible
sun-flare wash: sections enter with a soft warm bloom sweep (flare-alias gradient translating through), 1200ms, once per section
print misregistration: on hover/focus of display type and poster-panel media, the misprint-alias color layers offset ±2px for 400ms ease skank — like a screenprint pulled slightly off-registration
walking-bass parallax: hero video at 0.35 ratio, layered type drifts at 0.15 — slow, behind-the-beat
marquee tide: gig/track ticker drifts at 28s/loop, pauses on hover
motion.reduced_motion_contract: all scroll scrub and drift off; entrances become 200ms opacity fades

perf.device_tiering: poster-first video, loop only >= 768px + save-data off

spec.hero: daytime drone/coast footage (band-jam.mp4 is the daytime clip), sun-washed + slight warm print grade via CSS filter, soft paper-bleach scrim
spec.grain: SVG fractalNoise pseudo-element, full-page, opacity 0.05, pointer-events none
spec.halftone: subtle halftone-dot layer (radial-gradient dot matrix, ~3px pitch, Walnut at 0.03-0.05 alpha) over media and the dark anchor section — the screenprint tell
spec.paper: very soft paper-fiber texture on canvas via the grain filter's low-frequency octave; edges of media get a 1px Walnut keyline frame like poster panels

layout.hero_archetype: film still (LOCKED at hero-lock): full-bleed sun-washed video, editorial type block low-left, mono metadata line top-right, REC/frame-counter framing — flyer meets film still, now in daylight
section_order: music (two singles as full-width editorial slabs w/ embedded players)
layout.nav: minimal fixed top bar — wordmark left, three lowercase links + sun-flare 'listen' pill right; backdrop blur over canvas
layout.grid: 12-col fluid, max 1360px, gutters 24px; slabs may break the grid full-bleed
industry_patterns: shows list even if empty ('no shows booked — check back')

copy.voice: how a band member texts the group chat: lowercase, 2-8 words, zero marketing energy, boring is ok

bad: Experience the sound of the islands!
the kind of tuesday where nothing happens and everything matters

conversion.primary_cta: listen on Spotify (persistent sun-flare pill + per-song embeds)
journeys: hear 30 seconds of a song without leaving the page
trust_signals: Spotify embeds with actual play counts

constraints.a11y: WCAG AA contrast on light canvas; focus-visible rings in Sun Flare; reduced-motion honored
constraints.performance: static site, no framework runtime; GSAP + ScrollTrigger only JS; videos lazy + poster
constraints.stack: static HTML/CSS/JS (Vite optional), GSAP motion spine, deploys to existing Vercel project
constraints.assets_available: 2 hero/jam video loops (+full versions), 8 photos, 2 Spotify singles, behold.so feed id in current site

anti_patterns.reason: washed-out means lifted blacks and bloomed (not clipped) whites; haze is the brand
tourist Hawaii — the band is local surf-indie culture, not a resort

anti_patterns.ban: dark moody nocturne as the page's base register
anti_patterns.reason: rejected at hero-lock; the rebrand lives in bleached daylight — dark exists only as the single Washed Ocean anchor section

anti_patterns.ban: hype language, urgency, fire emoji energy
anti_patterns.reason: 86-100 BPM music; desperate marketing breaks the easy trust
the motion register is behind-the-beat; quick pops read as SaaS
editorial low-left/asymmetric composition is the film-still signature (locked)
every hue passes through the wash — ~20% desaturated, sun-faded; saturation reads as digital, not film
